title: Gaza issues meningitis epidemic alert after steep rise in cases
summary_full: Health ministry records 272 new infections in October, more than eight times the normal monthly rateGaza’s health ministry has issued an epidemic alert after a sharp rise in meningitis infections, with more than 270 new cases reported in October.Dr Nidal Ghoneim, a senior official at the ministry, said the spread of the disease posed a threat to the lives of hundreds of thousands of people, including children.
